title: Adobe’s Premiere mobile app is adding licensed music from ‘leading artists’
summary: Adobe Premiere mobile app adds licensed music from leading artists
detailed: Adobe is teaming up with Universal Music Group and Warner Music Group to add a library of licensed music clips to the Premiere mobile video editing app.
